name: TruthHypo
description: TruthHypo is a benchmark for assessing LLMs' capabilities in generating truthful scientific hypotheses, built on a biomedical knowledge graph (PubTator 3.0) with temporal partitioning to simulate the progression of scientific discovery. It includes KnowHD, a knowledge-based hallucination detector that evaluates how well hypotheses are grounded in existing knowledge.
reputation: Published at IJCAI 2025; provides controlled environment for evaluating scientific hypothesis truthfulness
notes: Uses temporal graph partitioning into 'seen' and 'unseen' subsets based on publication years; KnowHD analyzes reasoning processes to identify hallucinated hypotheses; human evaluations validate utility for accelerating scientific discovery.
